title: Bilingual ANVISA Regulatory RAG Prototype
description: Finalized revision release of the archived ANVISA RAG manuscript and reproducibility evidence. Adds the dated 188-question corpus comparison and provisional AI output assessments, Figure 6, Supplementary Data S16 and source-dependency audit; S13 run-date ledger; S14 full rule audit; corrected historical score-exposure provenance; consolidated responses and seven 600-dpi TIFF figures. Historical/coauthor results and initial AI judgments remain separate. All supplied reviewer comments discussed and responses approved; this is not a journal submission. Current-law accuracy, fresh independent external validation and measured workflow benefit remain unestablished. See REVIEW_STATUS.md and the file inventory. No new model calls were made for release preparation.
